milestone.title: Install & distribution architecture v2 (harness registry engine)

intent.outcome: A single mp install command deploys the full toolkit (mp + raul binaries, convention file, master-planner + spec-grill skills) to any harness via the data-driven registry from M56. Adding a harness means adding a registry entry, not editing install logic.

problem.description: mp install is hardcoded for two harnesses (opencode, cursor) with paths duplicated across install.rs, make install, and templates/harness/. Adding a new harness means editing multiple files. raul is never installed. Agent profiles don't exist. There's no per-harness convention file (AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md vs .clinerules). The install surface never caught up with v2.0.

in_scope: mp install --harness <id> (default opencode) consumes the registry from M56. --harness a,b for multi-harness. -g for global, omit for project-scoped.

Each install deploys: (a) mp + raul binaries to bin dir; (b) convention file (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/.clinerules) pointing to master-plan/AGENTS.md; (c) master-planner skill; (d) spec-grill skill (authored in M39).
Symmetric mp uninstall --harness/--global/--purge: removes harness artifacts, preserves shared binaries unless --purge.
mp doctor verifies the full installed surface per harness using the M56 registry: binaries, convention file, skills.
Convention file deployment per harness: opencode -> AGENTS.md, claude-code -> CLAUDE.md, cursor -> .cursor/rules/, cline -> .clinerules, etc.
mp install self-test (smoke) for CI: roundtrip install + doctor on a temp dir to catch regressions.
Update docs (INSTALL.md, ADOPTION-CHECKLIST.md), AGENTS.md, and the migration path from the old install layout.
out_of_scope: The harness registry itself and the Make-to-Rust bridge (M56 owns both; M51 consumes them).
Authoring the spec-grill skill content (M39 owns it; M51 only deploys the file).
Agent profile templates (plan/execution/review) — parked as an idea pending product-design validation.
Configurable code review step — split into its own milestone (it changes milestone-completion semantics).
Per-harness skill content variation (one canonical master-planner deploys to all).
GUI/web installer or auto-detection of installed harnesses.

design_decisions.rationale: M56 provides the HarnessDescriptor struct and registry; M51 consumes it and adds the install engine. The engine reads registry paths via mp install --print-paths and deploys skills. No new crate deps needed — reuse existing store/install modules.

work_packages.name: Install engine on M56 registry
work_packages.goal: mp install/uninstall/doctor driven by the M56 harness registry; deploys binaries + convention file + skills per harness

work_packages.name: Skills & convention deployment
work_packages.goal: Deploy master-planner + spec-grill skills and per-harness convention files via the registry; raul binary deploy

work_packages.name: Self-test & consistency
work_packages.goal: mp install --print-paths consistency with make install; CI smoke test (install + doctor roundtrip on temp dir)

work_packages.name: Documentation & migration
work_packages.goal: Update INSTALL.md, ADOPTION-CHECKLIST.md, AGENTS.md; migration guide from old install layout

steps.action: Consume the HarnessDescriptor + default_registry from M56 (crates/mp/src/harness.rs). Wire the v2 install engine to read harness metadata from the registry instead of hardcoded opencode/cursor branches.
steps.done_when: HarnessDescriptor + default registry implemented; tests pass

steps.action: Refactor mp install --harness <id> to use the M56 registry. --harness opencode is default. --harness a,b for multi-harness. -g for global, omit for project-scoped. Each deploy: binaries, convention file, skills.
steps.done_when: mp install uses registry; install_registry tests pass

steps.action: Implement mp uninstall --harness/--global/--purge driven by the M56 registry. Remove per-harness artifacts. Shared binaries stay unless --purge.
steps.done_when: mp uninstall removes harness artifacts correctly

steps.action: Update mp doctor to verify the full installed surface per harness using the M56 registry: binaries present, convention file, skills.
steps.done_when: mp doctor reports per-harness install status

steps.action: Deploy the spec-grill skill (authored in M39) via the install registry manifest. Wire master-planner + spec-grill into one mp install command so both skills land together.
steps.done_when: spec-grill skill exists with 3-round adversarial flow

steps.action: Deploy the raul binary via the install registry alongside mp (today only mp is deployed; raul is never installed — see problem statement). Verify raul lands in the bin dir per harness.

Implement convention file deployment per harness using the M56 registry: opencode -> AGENTS.md, claude-code -> CLAUDE.md, cursor -> .cursor/rules/, cline -> .clinerules, etc. Each convention file points to master-plan/AGENTS.md.
steps.done_when: Each harness deploys its correct convention file

steps.action: Wire skill, raul binary, and convention-file deployment into the install flow. mp install --harness opencode deploys mp+raul binaries, master-planner + spec-grill skills, and the convention file in one command.
steps.done_when: Full install flow works end-to-end for opencode

steps.action: Ensure the v2 install stays consistent with make install via the M56 --print-paths bridge: verify mp install and make install resolve to identical paths for each harness; add a consistency test.
Add an mp install self-test (smoke) for CI: roundtrip install + doctor on a temp dir, assert no missing artifacts, assert uninstall cleans up.
steps.done_when: Code review gate blocks complete; list-pending-review shows waiting milestones

steps.action: Update docs/concepts/02.../INSTALL.md and ADOPTION-CHECKLIST.md for the new install flow (harness registry, raul binary deploy, skill deployment).

Update AGENTS.md with the new install flow documentation (mp install --harness, raul deployment, /spec-grill activation reference). Note: agent profiles and code-review step are separate milestones/ideas.
steps.done_when: AGENTS.md updated with code review and agent roles

steps.action: Write migration guide from old install layout to new harness registry layout. Include a migration script or manual steps.
End-to-end verification: run mp install --harness opencode on a fresh environment, verify mp+raul binaries + convention file + skills deployed correctly. Verify uninstall cleans up.
steps.done_when: E2E test passes on fresh environment

verification.evidence: Install engine refactored to use M56 harness registry; multi-harness install/uninstall; raul binary deployed; spec-grill skill deployed; convention file deployment; install and doctor tests pass
